composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Use pale blue-gray surroundings and restrained sunlight, creating balanced surprise through material contrast and graceful shape. Vertical 1024x1536.
